claim: Johnson & Johnson's fiscal Q2 2025 revenue was its highest ever, at $25.6 billion.
summary: From existing knowledge alone without external sources, neither the $25.6 billion Q2 2025 figure nor its record-high status can be conclusively established.

sub_claims.text: Johnson & Johnson's fiscal Q2 2025 revenue was $25.6 billion.
sub_claims.note: Without external sources the exact Q2 2025 revenue figure cannot be conclusively established from existing knowledge alone.

sub_claims.text: That Q2 2025 revenue was Johnson & Johnson's highest ever quarterly revenue.
sub_claims.note: Record-high status requires comparison to all prior quarters which is not established by existing knowledge alone without sources.
